blocks.text: Alexandra Eala put up a valiant fight against Diana Shnaider but lost in straight sets, 7-5, 6-4, in the Ningbo Open, where Shnaider reached the finals three years ago. Shnaider, the tournament’s sixth seed, will advance to the quarterfinals and face Iva Jovic, who sent off Jasmine Paolini in straight sets, 6-4, 6-3, earlier in the day. It was the first time Eala and Shnaider met across the net. They stayed mostly on the baselines, exchanging blistering drives that found the far corners of the hard court, for one hour and 55 minutes. READ ALSO: Alex Eala Tracker 2026: Matches, News, […]...
